description: Plain-English pickleball guides and honest gear picks for new players, and for anyone who wants to keep playing for years. No jargon, no hype.

author_blurb: Judy is a recreational pickleball player who started SmartSelect Labs with her son, Lewis, to write the plain-English guides and honest gear picks she wished she had when she started. When she has not used a product herself, she says so.
